value.description: A value to pass to the command. Some commands can take a value as an argument. Refer to the commands for more information.

platforms.description: An array of platform. Each platform is an ID (GUID) or a unique name. Some commands can take platforms as arguments. Refer to the commands for more information.

command.description: The ID of the command to execute. Refer to \ref globalcommandsids for the lists of commands.

objects.description: An array of objects. Each object is an ID (GUID), name, or path of the object. Some commands can take objects as arguments. Refer to the commands for more information.

examples.description: Finds the specified objects in the Project Explorer view (Selection Channel 1), and selects them.
examples.title: Finding and selecting objects in Project Explorer
